name: ansys-fluent
description: Control and diagnose local ANSYS Fluent 2024 R1 from Codex through safe MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Check and drive local Fluent workflows.
interface.longDescription: Local tools for checking ANSYS components and licenses, testing PyFluent solver and meshing connections, opening CAD models, listing project CAD inputs, and running reviewed Fluent journals.
defaultPrompt: Check my local ANSYS Fluent environment.
Run the Fluent solver and meshing smoke tests.
Inspect the CAD files for my water-jacket project.
